data.name: Mujammil
data.gender_notes: Mujammil is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Mujammil is derived from the Arabic language and means 'well-covered, clothed'. In Islamic culture, the name represents the idea of being covered and protected, both physically and spiritually. This name is also mentioned in the Quran, where it is given to a companion of the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) named Mujammil ibn Jabalah.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that signifies being enveloped by the divine protection of Allah.
data.etymology: Mujammil belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Well-covered, clothed.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mujammil total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

in_urdu.name: مجمّل
